title: Electronic Referral and Booking of Outpatient Day Case Surgery Compared With Traditional Referral Routines.
brief_summary: We want in this study to investigate the cost-effectiveness and waiting time of direct electronic referral and booking of outpatient surgery compared to the traditional patient pathway where the patient is seen at the outpatient clinic prior to surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients were eligible if they were diagnosed by their GP for an inguinal hernia, sinus pilonidalis or gallstone disease which require surgical treatment.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with medical conditions making them unfit for outpatient surgery admitted to the surgical department prior to surgery are not eligible
